title: Publish the provisional GPU-centric AI for Science configuration planner
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 7, 2026 instruction to publish the GPU-centric AI for Science configuration-planning Candidate on OpenFS Pages. Publication is limited to the bilingual browser-local planning interface and the exact public Candidate inputs pinned by SHA-256 in GPU-PLANNER-PUBLICATION-001. The page must remain visibly provisional, single-model and single-agent, Consensus-incomplete, and prohibited for procurement use. Unknown prices, delivery conditions, facility constraints, workload demand, and performance evidence must remain unavailable or Coverage Gaps. User inputs, estimated budgets, and generated configurations must not be sent to GA4 or any other external service. This authorizes preparation of a Pull Request and publication after an authorized merge and successful Pages deployment; it does not authorize merging the Pull Request, asserting scientific Consensus, recommending a vendor, or publishing non-public information.
